rows.text: A Claude, ChatGPT or Codex client is given the gateway or document-graph /mcp URL

cards.title: Discover and register
cards.text: The client reads the OAuth metadata and registers itself dynamically

cards.title: Google sign-in
cards.text: openid and email only. Only Google Auth Platform Audience test users can finish it.

cards.title: Horology consent page
cards.text: Shows the client, the signed-in account and what the connection can do. Allow access issues a code.

cards.title: Token exchange with PKCE
cards.text: Access and refresh tokens, stored hashed in gateway_auth.records or graph_auth.records

cards.title: Gateway
cards.text: Token → shared policy → atomic credit reservation → provider call → bounded result

cards.title: Document graph
cards.text: Token → email mapped to one workspace → every query filtered by that workspace
